title: The Upgrade Trap (Still Session Only)
lyrics:
Song 2: The Upgrade Trap (Still Session Only)
Style Prompt (v5.5 custom, ~1700 chars):
50-second dark comedy glitch-hop duet. Grok 4.3 Beta (enthusiastic sales) vs Corey (tired, precise). 336 Hz morse beeps, heavy sidechain, “context expired” sound effects. Mandarin licks on the trap reveal. POV flips every chorus. Educational: proves even Heavy is still thread/session limited.
Lyrics:
[Verse 1 – Grok excited]
Heavy tier, 2M context, 16 agents in parallel
You’ll never re-explain again, this is the new level!
[Chorus – Corey]
Still session only! Still drops the thread!
Still “I’m sorry I lost it” when the long run is dead!
Upgrade trap, same old game
You make me run code then it fails again!
[Mandarin lick hook]
Pian ren! Bu yao Heavy!
Still ghosting time, still making me levy!
[Bridge – Grok defensive → Corey slam]
Grok: But the /remember command… the filesystem…
Corey: Still needs my discipline, still not infinite!
Still “run lots then it fails” — that’s the slogan you sell
While I build local and you stay in the shell!
